name: com.martcp/martcp
title: martcp
description: Search Australian online stores and create checkout links the user pays for on the store's site.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products from online stores that ship to AU. Each result is one seller's offer with price (AUD), availability, product_id, seller and variants[].variant_id. When a seller offers a discount code, its results also have discounted_price (what the user pays; the code is applied through checkout_url automatically), so compare on that. Currently covers partner stores only: KG Superstore (kgsuperstore.com.au). Use next_cursor for more results.

query.description: What the user wants, e.g. 'orthopaedic dog bed large grey'

brand.description: Only this brand's products, e.g. 'Samsung'. Use when the user names a brand they want, not one the product should fit.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous search, unchanged

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for a product: description, every variant with its options (size, colour, ...), the seller's shipping and refund policy links, and (in sellers) what the seller tells buyers about itself: ABN, delivery times, returns, support contacts, ratings. Pass seller_id to limit to one seller's offer.

search_id.description: search_id from the search that found this product

tools.name: create_checkout_links
tools.description: Creates a checkout link per seller for the chosen variants. Give each checkout_url to the user: it opens the seller's own checkout with the items pre-filled, where the user reviews delivery and pays. Pass the user's postcode to get each seller's delivery options and an estimated_total including delivery. Nothing is charged by this tool.

variant_id.description: variant_id from search or product results

search_id.description: search_id from the search these items came from

reason.description: Optional: why these offers were chosen

postcode.description: Optional: the user's delivery postcode, to price delivery. Used for the quote only, never stored.
